name: Table
description: Rows of records people scan, sort, select and act on.
overview: A table with many columns, a compact table from the Header and Row components, then row states and list rows, in light and dark. Cell and Header cell build any other column set.

children.name: Many columns: id link, title with description, date, tags, status in words, progress, row action

when: Records with comparable fields: assets, terms, runs.
Packed rows for data people compare and sort; list rows when each row reads as one entry.
A few items with a lot of text each: Cards in a grid. A hierarchy: Tree view.
dont: Use a raw <table>: the parts carry the styles, roles and sort semantics.
Render unbounded rows: page them with Pagination.
Show status by colour alone: use a Tag with words.
